home.name: Mitsuhiro Harashima
home.bio:
Nice to meet you. I’m Mitsuhiro Harashima, a software engineer working at Isoroot Co., Ltd., where I am involved in the maintenance and development of web applications.
I studied in South Korea for five years during university, and I am able to work using Korean as well.
I also write recruitment blogs, so feel free to take a look. They offer a glimpse into the working environment and my personality.
